evidence.field: 走 / glyph sequence and paleographic interpretation
evidence.text: The page identifies examples for 走 across oracle-bone, bronze, Warring States, seal, clerical, and regular forms. It interprets the oracle-bone form as a running person with swinging arms; says later bronze forms sometimes add other elements, after which the original figure is interpreted as both semantic and phonetic; and describes later forms as increasingly altered. It lists oracle-bone Heji 27939, Western Zhou 大盂鼎 (集成2837), and bronze examples through Spring and Autumn and Warring States. These are the page's modern paleographic interpretations, not direct proof of each proposed component role.
evidence.title: 走字形演变字源_汉字「走」_走的甲骨文_走的金文

evidence.text: The exact file page identifies the vector as 走 in Shuowen seal-script style. It cites Sinica Database and Chinese Etymology among the sources and names a Sinica record for this image. The page reports that the selected Sinica image has CC0 1.0 dedication, while its permission section also refers to Richard Sears terms; the exact file is a digital rendering, not a photograph of an ancient artifact. Its “other versions” section lists script labels including Shang oracle, Western Zhou bronze, and Warring States bronze, but these labels alone do not verify separate usable image URLs.

search_audit.query: 走 字形演变 甲骨文 金文 说文 走 字源; Wikimedia Commons File 走-seal.svg Shuowen Seal Radical 026 SVG
search_audit.outcome: Search located and the researcher opened the character-specific Guoxuedashi sequence and the exact Commons file page for 走-seal.svg. Search results also included other relevant pages, but their snippets were not used as evidence.

search_audit.query: Direct original file and alternative script versions linked from Wikimedia Commons File:走-seal.svg
search_audit.outcome: The Commons page exposed the direct original-file URL, but fetching the image returned a cache miss. The linked script-version categories were opened; they did not establish a character-specific alternative image. The local lead Shuowen Seal Radical 026 could not be opened as an exact Commons description page.

gaps: The original SVG bytes could not be retrieved by the web tool, so the file is a sourced candidate but its pixels were not visually inspected.
The proposed secondary Commons lead Shuowen Seal Radical 026.svg was inaccessible, and no exact inspected description page was established for it; it is not proposed.
No direct, character-specific oracle-bone image candidate with a verifiable exact Commons description page and image URL was established in this pass.

items.period: Qin/Han small-seal tradition as represented in the Shuowen seal-script style; the glyph file itself is a modern digital rendering, not an ancient artifact photograph.
items.caption: 走 in a modern digital rendering of the Shuowen seal-script form, useful for comparing the received seal tradition with later clerical and regular forms.
items.alt: A black seal-script rendering of 走 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons file page identifies the graph and script style, supplies a direct original SVG link, and reports Sinica-image CC0 provenance; this gives a sourced candidate illustrating the received seal-script stage in the form history.
items.rights: Commons file page reports the Sinica Database image as CC0 1.0; page also records Richard Sears permission terms for associated material. Verify image-level attribution during acquisition. This is a modern rendering.

limitations.text: The direct SVG fetch failed with cache miss, so no pixel-level inspection is claimed; the visual agent should confirm that the downloaded image matches the description before final selection.
The Commons page lists other script-version labels, but their exact file-description pages and direct links were not verified; no such alternatives are proposed.
